blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) differ widely in pretraining objective, modality and resolution, and none leads across benchmarks. We ask whether their representations are complementary, and whether a single encoder can inherit that complementarity. We introduce Pangaea-Latents, an extension of the Pangaea benchmark providing frozen embeddings of $5$ GFMs over its $11$ datasets, along with reproduced baselines, and find GFM embeddings to be neither redundant nor disjoint. We then propose GeoMixture, a preliminary framework to align a ViT to several GFMs per dataset through a multi-representation alignment (mREPA) objective. Our encoder ties the best GFM in average rank across nine Pangaea datasets, trading peak performance for cross-task consistency.
blocks.zh: 地理空间基础模型在培训前目标、模式和解决方面差别很大,没有一种模式可以跨越基准。 我们问它们的陈述是否相辅相成,单一编码器是否能够继承这种互补性。 我们介绍了Pangaea-Latents,这是Pangaea基准的延伸,该基准在其11美元数据集上提供了5美元GFM的冷冻嵌入,以及复制的基线,并发现GFM嵌入既不是多余的也不是脱节的。 然后,我们提出GeoMixture,这是一个初步框架,通过多代表对齐(mREPA)目标,使每个数据集的VIT与几个GFM一致。 我们的编码器将九套Pangaea数据集的平均最佳GFM联结起来,用峰值性能来交换交叉任务的一致性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
GFMs have the potential to transform Earth and environmental sciences by learning processes from measurements at planetary scale [ 31 ] .
Trained by self-supervised learning (SSL) on terabytes of satellite recordings without ground-truth supervision, they map observations from heterogeneous sensors, wavelengths, resolutions and dates onto dense Earth embeddings, reusable for arbitrary downstream tasks [ 17 ] .
Benchmarks probe how well these frozen representations adapt across regimes, tasks and geographies [ 19 , 20 , 3 ] , Pangaea [ 20 ] being widely adopted for its diversity and its evaluation framework suited to ViT backbones.
Yet no single GFM leads across benchmarks [ 5 ] .
One plausible reason is that pretraining objectives, modalities and architectures differ across GFMs (Sec. 2 ), each covering a different region of the downstream task landscape.
blocks.zh:
GFM具有通过从行星尺度的测量中学习过程来改变地球和环境科学的潜力[31].
在无地面实况监测的情况下,通过自我监督的卫星记录几兆字节学习(SSL),将来自各种传感器、波长、分辨率和日期的观测图映射到密集的地球嵌入物上,用于任意的下游任务[17]。
基准调查这些被冻结的表述如何在各种制度、任务和地理图[19、20、3]、Pangaea[20] 之间适应性如何,因其多样性及其适用于虚拟技术支柱的评价框架被广泛采用。
然而,没有任何一个GFM领导跨越基准[5]。
一个合理的原因是,培训前的目标、模式和结构因全球调频方案而异(第2款),每个方案涵盖下游任务环境的不同区域。

blocks.en:
Combining GFMs encoding different information could broaden coverage at a fraction of the cost of pretraining another model [ 21 ] . Weight-space merging [ 10 ] requires architecture compatibility and released checkpoints, excluding embedding-only models, e.g. AlphaEarth [ 4 ] ; combination in latent space has neither constraint. We explore it by first introducing Pangaea-Latents , an extension of Pangaea providing the embeddings of 5 5 GFMs for each of 11 11 datasets, with baselines reproduced over 3 3 seeds.
We analyze their similarity and complementarity, finding that the benefit of mixing them depends on the dataset and is not predicted by their similarity.
We then propose GeoMixture , a framework aligning a ViT with several GFMs through a multi-representation alignment (mREPA) objective, aiming not for the best score on every dataset but for consistency across the benchmark.
blocks.zh:
将不同信息的GFM编码整合起来,可以扩大覆盖面,其成本相当于预先训练另一种模型的一小部分[21]. 重量空间合并[10]要求建筑兼容性和释放检查点,不包括仅嵌入式模型,例如AlphaEarth[4];在潜伏空间中的结合既无约束. 我们首先通过介绍Pangaea-Latents进行探索,Pangaea的扩展为11个数据集中的每个数据集提供5个5GFM的嵌入,基线复制了3个种子。
我们分析它们的相似性和互补性,发现混合它们的好处取决于数据集,而不是以它们的相似性来预测.
然后,我们提出GeoMixture,即一个框架,通过多代表对齐(mREPA)目标,使虚拟数据与若干全球调频相配合,目的不是在每个数据集取得最佳分数,而是实现基准的一致性。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: GFMs explore a wide range of SSL objectives on multimodal remote sensing data: masked image modelling [ 28 , 3 , 15 , 8 ] , contrastive and hybrid objectives [ 9 , 26 , 11 , 2 , 27 , 7 ] , and joint-embedding predictive architectures [ 1 ] . Others target modality-specific properties such as scale [ 23 , 13 ] , temporal dynamics [ 25 ] , spectral heterogeneity [ 12 ] or geolocation [ 16 ] , or structuring the latent space by modality with Mixtures of Experts (MoE) [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: GFM探索一系列广泛的SSL关于多式联运数据的目标:蒙面图像建模[28,3,15,8],对比和混合目标[9,26,11,2,27,7],以及联合嵌入式预测架构[1]. 另一些则针对特定模式的特性,如尺度[23,13],时间动态[25],光谱异质性[12]或地理定位[16],或按照与专家混合(MOE)[30]的模式来构建潜在的空间。

blocks.en:
Whether such diverse recipes converge to similar representations is an open question, raised for vision models in general [ 14 ] . In the geospatial setting, Plas et al. [21] propose a complementarity score estimating whether two stacked GFM embeddings should improve performance on a task, a useful prior but based on linear probes that does not yield to a deployable model.
We extend this analysis to another set of GFMs within the Pangaea framework.
blocks.zh:
对于一般的愿景模式而言,这种多样化的配方是否与类似的表述趋同是一个未决问题。 在地理空间背景下,Plas等人. [21] 提出一个互补分数,估计两个堆叠的GFM嵌入器是否应该提高任务性能,这是一个有用的前期但基于线性探测器,不会屈服于可部署模型.
我们把这一分析扩大到潘加埃亚框架内的另外一套全球调频系统。

blocks.en: In weight space, Hanna et al. [10] sample GFM weights from a generative model, producing a model on demand at the price of sampling variability and a per-task cost. In the latent space, multi-teacher distillation yields, on natural images, a single backbone matching or exceeding its teachers [ 22 , 24 ] . We follow this line with a focus on representation alignment [ 29 ] , aligning a single ViT to N N GFMs through one lightweight projection per teacher.
blocks.zh: 在重量空间中,汉娜等人. [10]从基因模型中抽取GFM的重量样本,以采样可变性的价格按需求生成一个模型,每任务成本. 在潜在空间,多教师蒸馏在自然图像上产生单一骨干匹配或超过教师[22、24]。 我们沿着这条线走,重点是代表制配对[29],通过每个教师一个轻量级的预测,将一个VIT与N N GFM进行配对.

blocks.zh: 3 基准和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Pangaea-Latents
blocks.zh: 3.1 潘加埃亚-拉坦茨

blocks.en:
We propose Pangaea-Latents (Fig. 1(a) ), an extension of Pangaea [ 20 ] (App. B ) providing embeddings e i , j e_{i,j} for each of its D = 11 D=11 datasets i i and each of N = 5 N=5 GFMs j j : CROMA [ 9 ] , DOFA [ 28 ] , Prithvi [ 25 ] , Scale-MAE [ 23 ] and TerraMind-L [ 15 ] , spanning distinct pretraining objectives and input modalities. Each encoder is applied once to every split under its own preprocessing and band mapping, and the embedding produced by its last layer is stored, then standardized with min-max values per GFM and per dataset for our experiments.
Precomputing the latents decouples running the GFMs from training on top of them: a student is trained without a single forward pass through any GFM, making our setup (Sec. 3.3 ) tractable on one GPU. Further details are provided in App. C .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 reports scores aggregated on 11 Pangaea-Latents datasets (per-dataset results in App. F ), using standardized CKA as similarity given the limitations of CCA and CKA (Sec. 3.2 ). In line with Plas et al. [21] , GFM embeddings are on average partially similar and complementary, from dissimilar (Scale-MAE × \times DOFA, 0.26 0.26 ) to highly similar pairs (CROMA × \times TerraMind-L, 0.83 0.83 ).
Both scores depend on the dataset, and similarity does not reliably predict complementarity. Dissimilar pairs can be complementary (Prithvi × \times DOFA on DynamicEarthNet, Fig. 5 : similarity 0.17 0.17 , complementarity 0.10 0.10 ), and on Sen1Floods11 (Fig. 10 ), pairs with similarity 0.36 0.36 and 0.70 0.70 reach comparable complementarity ( 0.12 0.12 – 0.16 0.16 ). Yet CROMA × \times TerraMind-L is not complementary on CropTypeMapping (Fig. 4 ; similarity 0.77 0.77 , complementarity − 0.03 -0.03 ).
The complementarity score highlights promising pairs ( e.g. Scale-MAE × \times DOFA on HLSBurnScars, Fig. 7 ) but becomes unreliable on high-dimensional latents, where ridge regression overfits and is sensitive to regularization ( e.g. CROMA self-pair on MADOS, Fig. 8 ), and it collapses to the majority class on imbalanced datasets ( e.g. SpaceNet7, Fig. 11 ).
Overall, global similarity measures may miss the localized latent signals that drive complementarity, which a linear probe may not capture reliably.

We follow the Pangaea protocol (App. B ) with 3 3 seeds (Tab. 1 ): encoders are frozen with a supervised UPerNet decoder, and the UNet is trained end-to-end. GeoMixture is aligned on the unlabeled training images of each Pangaea-Latents dataset, unseen by the GFMs during pretraining. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and future work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We introduced Pangaea-Latents , an extension of Pangaea supporting research on GFM representation alignment, and GeoMixture , aligning a single ViT to five GFMs through a multi-representation alignment objective.
Aligned to several teachers, GeoMixture ties the best GFM in average rank and is more consistent across datasets, while ranking first on only one.
Two limitations bound these results. Alignment is performed per dataset, so the student sees the target imagery, without labels, while the GFMs do not; the comparison measures how well a representation can be specialized rather than how well it transfers. The evaluation also covers nine of eleven datasets, and the alignment loss, which is not a neutral choice, is ablated on only five.
In future work, we will complete the benchmark, explore additional losses, and scale to additional GFMs [ 12 , 26 , 1 , 13 , 16 , 27 , 7 ] , including AlphaEarth [ 4 ] , which releases embeddings but no backbone. Aligning on a large multimodal corpus [ 26 ] rather than per dataset would remove the specialization confound and test whether a single GeoMixture encoder transfers across the benchmark.
blocks.zh:
Pangaea-Latents是Pangaea支持GFM代表比对研究的延伸,GeoMixture通过多代表比对目标,将单一的VIT比对5个GFM。
GeoMixture与多位教师相配合,将GFM的平均排名与最佳GFM挂钩,各数据集之间更为一致,而排名仅位居第一.
有两个限制约束着这些结果。 每个数据集都进行对齐,因此学生可以看到目标图像,没有标签,而GFM则没有;比较衡量一个代表能够在多大程度上专业化,而不是如何转移. 评价还涵盖11个数据集中的9个,对齐损失并非中性选择,只减少5个。
在未来的工作中,我们将完成基准,探索更多的损失,并扩展到额外的GFM[12,26,1,13,16,27,7],包括释放嵌入但无主干线的AlphaEarth[4]. 在大型多模式体上保持一致[26],而不是每个数据集,将消除专门性,并测试单一的地理混合编码器是否跨越基准转移。

never updated and only a task decoder is trained on its multi-scale features. The recipe is
determined by three properties of the (encoder, dataset) pair, the task type (whether the loader
returns a time series), and which modalities the two share, and is otherwise identical across the
grid. Table 3 gives the mapping.

blocks.en:
Single-date segmentation uses a UPerNet head with 512 channels over the encoder’s feature pyramid.
For multi-temporal datasets (CropTypeMapping, PASTIS, DynamicEarthNet, BioMassters) the frozen
encoder is applied independently to each time step and the resulting sequence of feature maps is
fused by a lightweight temporal attention encoder (L-TAE) before the UPerNet head; this is what
allows single-date foundation models to be evaluated on time series at all. Change detection
(SpaceNet7, xView2) uses a Siamese UPerNet that encodes both acquisitions with the same frozen
weights and concatenates their features before decoding. Regression replaces the classification head
with a regression UPerNet. The from-scratch UNet baseline brings its own decoder family and, being
a convolutional network without a multi-scale token grid, handles time by folding the temporal axis
into the input channels. In every case the decoder’s logits are bilinearly interpolated to the
target’s spatial size before the loss and the metrics are computed.

编码器独立应用于每个时段,由此产生的特征图序列是

(SpaceNet7, xView2) 使用暹罗 UPer 将两件被冻结的东西编码的网络
在解码前,重量和调理它们的特征. 递归取代分类头

输入频道。 在每一种情况下,解码器的对数都是双线插值
目标在损失和衡量标准计算之前的空间大小。

blocks.en:
Every scene is reduced to the encoder’s expected input (224 px for DOFA, Prithvi, Scale-MAE
and TerraMind, 120 px for CROMA), and the native scene size for UNet by one of three
policies. Scenes larger than the encoder input are randomly cropped at training time and processed
by sliding window at test time. MADOS instead uses a focus crop guaranteed to contain labelled
pixels, because a uniform crop of its sparse annotation frequently yields an all-ignore target and an
undefined loss. Scenes smaller than the encoder input (CropTypeMapping at 64 2 64^{2} , PASTIS at 128 2 128^{2} ) are bilinearly resized rather than cropped (the label is left at its native resolution)
and are evaluated whole rather than by sliding window. Spectral bands are then filtered to those the
encoder declares, normalized, and zero-padded where the encoder expects a band the dataset does not
provide, so an encoder is never silently fed a mismatched channel order. Normalization is per-band
mean/standard-deviation for segmentation and change detection and min–max for regression. For
modality-flexible encoders the modality set is restricted to the intersection with the dataset’s, so
an any-to-any model is evaluated on optical-only data rather than being excluded or fed a fake
SAR input.

和 TerraMind, 120 px for CROMA),以及UNet 的本土场景大小 3 之一
政策。 大于编码器输入的场景在训练时随机裁剪和处理
通过测试时的滑动窗口。 MADOS 转而使用保证含有标签的重点作物

未定义的损失。 比编码器输入小的场景(CropTypeMapping at 64 2 64^{2},PATIS at 128 2 128^{2})是双线调整大小而不是裁剪(标签在原生分辨率上留下).
而不是通过滑动窗口来评价。 然后将光谱带过滤到那些

任何一种到任何一种模型都通过光学数据加以评价,而不是被排除或装入假的
搜索和救援输入。

blocks.en:
All runs use AdamW ( lr = 10 − 4 \text{lr}=10^{-4} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , weight decay 0.05 0.05 ) with a multi-step
schedule that decays the learning rate at 60 % 60\% and 90 % 90\% of the total iterations, batch size 8 per
device, fp32 precision, and 80 epochs.
The loss is cross-entropy for multi-class tasks, Dice for the single-logit binary masks
(AI4SmallFarms, SpaceNet7), and MSE for regression. Validation runs every 5 epochs and the reported
checkpoint is the best-scoring one: by validation mIoU for every segmentation and change-detection
dataset except AI4SmallFarms, which selects on the IoU of its positive class, and by validation MSE
for regression.

blocks.en:
Segmentation and change detection are reported as mIoU, the mean of the per-class IoU over all
classes other than the ignore index; the binary datasets are scored over two classes, since the
benchmark’s evaluator sizes its confusion matrix from the class-name list even where the decoder
emits a single logit. Regression is reported as RMSE. Every (encoder, dataset) cell is run with three
seeds and we report mean ± \pm standard deviation. Because RMSE is lower-is-better while mIoU is
higher-is-better, across datasets with different metrics, aggregates are computed as average rank; over the nine mIoU datasets of Tab. 1 , we also report average mIoU.

blocks.en: Appendix C Description of Pangaea-Latents

blocks.en:
Aligning a student to several GFMs requires their embeddings of the
same input. Recomputing them every epoch is wasteful and, for encoders that must be held
frozen, unnecessary. We therefore precompute them once into Pangaea-Latents (see Sec. 3.1 ).
Because the tiling is shared, a given (sample, tile) index refers to the same
spatial region for every GFM, which is what makes the embeddings comparable and the alignment target well defined.

每个GFM的空间区域,这就是使嵌入物具有可比性和精确定义对齐目标的原因。

blocks.en: C.1 What is stored

blocks.en:
A record is the last-layer grid of one tile of shape ( d , T , H ′ , W ′ ) (d,T,H^{\prime},W^{\prime}) stored in bfloat16 . The
time axis is always kept and never pooled; no pooled vector is stored, since the projection into a
shared space is learned downstream.
For our experiments with multi-temporal datasets, alignment is applied per frame.

Each (dataset, GFM, split) set is written as fixed-shape sharded .npy arrays (512 tiles per

blocks.en: C.2 The shared tiling
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 共享的天花板

blocks.en:
Tiles are cut at native resolution on a shared 224 224 -pixel grid (the largest GFM window) at
positions laid out by the same rule as Pangaea sliding-window evaluator, evenly spaced over [ 0 , size − tile ] [0,\,\text{size}-\text{tile}] . A GFM with a smaller window (CROMA, 120) resizes each tile
internally. The tile set is deliberately not identical to the evaluator’s: the evaluator
opens ⌈ size / input ⌉ \lceil\text{size}/\text{input}\rceil windows at each encoder’s own input size, which
would give a different set of crops per GFM, whereas a shared index requires one grid common to
all five.
Three policies cover the eleven datasets (Table 5 ): a 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid for
scenes much larger than a tile; a single centre tile for scenes only marginally larger, where a grid
would be almost entirely redundant overlap; and a single whole-scene tile, at the GFM’s input size,
for the three datasets Pangaea itself feeds whole.

blocks.en: C.3 Extraction
blocks.zh: C.3 采掘业

blocks.en:
One sample is processed as follows. It is read through Pangaea ’s validation preprocessor
for that dataset: band filtering, the dataset’s published normalization (mean/standard deviation,
or min–max for the regression task), band padding, and, for the datasets the benchmark resizes, its
resize with no random crop. Inputs are normalized exactly as the benchmark
normalizes it at evaluation time. The normalized scene is then tiled by the policy above, each tile is resized to the
GFM’s window, and the frozen encoder’s last-layer output is written to the dataset.
blocks.zh:
现对一个样品作如下处理。 通过Pangaea的验证预处理器读取
对于该数据集:波段过滤,数据集公布的正常化(平均值/标准偏差,
或回归任务的分数-最大值),波段粘贴,对数据集,基准调整大小
调整大小,不随意裁剪。 输入完全与基准一致
在评价时使其正常化。 平整的场景由上面的策略拼接,每块瓷砖都调整为
GFM 窗口和冷冻编码器的最后一层输出被写入数据集.

blocks.en:
Two details are related to the time axis. An encoder that natively uses time series as input (Prithvi) receives all T T frames in one forward pass, but only where the dataset configuration declares a time
series; single-date encoders are looped frame by frame and their grids stacked back into a T T axis.
Either way the stored grid has the same layout, so the time axis is available downstream regardless
of which GFM produced it. Encoders are instantiated through the same code path as the benchmark
sweep, including the per-cell recipe fixes, so a modality-flexible encoder is restricted to the
dataset’s modalities exactly as it is at evaluation.
blocks.zh:
两个细节与时间轴有关. 本地使用时间序列作为输入的编码器( Prithvi) 在一个前传中接收所有的 T T 帧, 但只有在数据集配置宣布时间时
序列; 单日期编码器按帧循环框架,其网格堆回T轴.
无论是哪种方式,存储的网格都有相同的布局,所以无论时间轴在下游都可以使用
其中GFM生产. 编码器通过与基准相同的代码路径即时化
扫描,包括每个细胞的食谱修正,所以一个模式弹性编码器仅限于
数据集的模式与评价时完全一样。

blocks.en:
Because the GFMs expect different band sets, what each one actually consumes differs: Pangaea ’s band
filter keeps the bands an encoder requests and the padding step zero-fills any it expects but the
dataset lacks. DOFA, whose band list is the dataset’s own, receives every available band unpadded;
the fixed-band encoders (CROMA and TerraMind-L at 12 optical bands, Prithvi at 6, Scale-MAE at 3) see
correspondingly less, and the optical-only encoders ignore SAR where a dataset provides it. These
padded channels carry no information and are recorded per cell rather than left implicit.
blocks.zh:
由于GFMs期望不同的乐队组合,因此每个乐队实际消耗的是不同的: 潘加埃亚乐队
过滤器将带保留在编码器请求中,并保留它期望的零填充步骤,但
缺少数据集。 DOFA,其乐队列表是数据集自己的,接收所有可用的乐队未加词;
固定波段编码器(CROMA和TerraMind-L为12个光学波段,Prithvi为6、Scale-MAE为3)见
相对较少,仅光学编码器忽略了数据集提供的SAR。 这些
添加通道没有信息,每个单元格都要记录,而不是隐含。

blocks.en: C.4 Determinism and verification
blocks.zh: C.4 决定因素与核查

blocks.en:
An embedding is only recorded if it is a function of its index. Two sources of randomness had to
be removed. Pangaea SpaceNet7 change-detection loader draws its temporal pair at random in
training mode; extraction forces the loader into its deterministic evaluation pairing. PASTIS
subsamples any acquisition series longer than 50 frames with an unseeded permutation, in every
split; extraction reads each sample under a seed derived from its ( dataset , split , index ) (\text{dataset},\text{split},\text{index}) identity, so the draw depends on the sample rather than
on when it was read.
blocks.zh:
嵌入只有在它是其索引的一个函数时才被记录. 两个来源的随机性不得不
被删除。 Pangaea SpaceNet7 变化探测加载器随机绘制其时间配对
训练模式; 提取器迫使装载器进入其决定性的评价配对。 序言
以未播种的轮廓对超过50帧的任何获取系列进行子样本,每集
拆分; 提取从它的种子( 数据集, 拆分, 索引) (\ text{ dataset},\ text{ split},\ text{ index}) 身份中得出的种子下读取每个样本, 所以画图取决于样本而不是
当它被读到。

blocks.en:
Correctness is then checked by re-extraction: random tiles are re-derived through the identical
build path and compared to the dataset, and the check passes only on bitwise equality. This
tests index correctness and forward determinism in one, and it is what caught the SpaceNet7 issue
above.
blocks.zh:
校正性通过再提取检查: 随机的瓦片通过相同的重新生成
构建路径并与数据集进行比较,检查仅通过位码平等。 这个
测试指数正确性和前向确定性,
见上文。

blocks.en: C.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: C.5 限制

blocks.en:
The tiling is a first version and is marked provisional in the store’s own manifest. Two
consequences are worth stating. Tiles are cut at 224 224 pixels and resized to each GFM’s window, so
CROMA, whose window is 120 120 , sees the shared tile at a different effective ground sampling distance
than it was pretrained at. And the tiling density is a coarse setting rather than a tuned one: the 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid covers
the 496 496 – 520 520 pixel scenes completely, but on the 1024 1024 pixel ones (DynamicEarthNet, xView2) it
leaves 352 352 of 1024 1024 pixels per axis unseen, where full coverage would need 5 × 5 5\times 5 ; and the
centre policy discards an 8 8 pixel border on MADOS and a 16 16 pixel one on SpaceNet7. Finally, the
per-sample seeding makes our extraction reproducible, but it does not make PASTIS’s frame
selection match what the benchmark itself samples at training time, which remains random run to run
upstream.

铺垫是第一个版本,在商店自己的货单上标有临时标记。 两个
后果值得说明。 在224,224像素下切片,并调整大小到每个GFM的窗口,所以
CROMA,其窗口为120 120,在不同的有效地面采样距离看到共享的瓦片
而不是被训练过 板块密度是粗糙的,而不是调制的: 3×3 3\时的3格网盖
